posts.text: Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway while my fertiliser bill doubled this year. Nice road. Who's paying for it, and will it ever get me cheaper diesel? Asking for every farmer in the north.

Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes
Ostrand says the Kessa highway is 'a new era of prosperity'. Fine. Did anyone ask what the inflation numbers look like for the families driving on it? Debate tonight, Arden on costings, let's see.

Watched the debate tonight. Ostrand kept pointing to the highway, but I'd like to see the inflation numbers over the full term, not just the last quarter. Arden's 200,000 jobs need a costing too. Both owe us the arithmetic.

Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway = 'new era of prosperity' lmao. Arden promising 200k jobs with zero costings = also cringe. Two weeks left and I still don't know who to trust. Someone pls convince me

Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North. My cab will thank the president, the suspension definitely won't. Ostrand's debate answer on inflation was solid though, let's see what the costings say. #Veloria

Watched the debate tonight. Ostrand kept saying 'inflation is down' but my grocery bill says otherwise. Arden's 200k jobs sound great, but where's the costing? Both need to show their numbers. Hospitals are already short-staffed.

Read VeriCheck's fact-check on Arden's VAT and fuel claims. Good that the false and misleading parts are flagged. But a 2% of GDP gap is not small. Before we call Arden's plan dead, Ostrand's team should also be asked how they plan to close their own gap on inflation.
Before I share a 'DOUBLE VAT' claim from a party page, I want the actual plan text and the costings. Anyone got the source document? #VeloriaVotes
posts.orig_text: Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: Fuel up 40% under Ostrand and my fertiliser bill doubled. Fancy highway, though. Before anyone shares a number, check it against the fact sheet and the election commission site. Not trusting anybody's stats this close to the vote.

Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. Good. But the same check says his plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Ostrand still owes us an answer on the inflation numbers too. Both need to show the math.

Two weeks out and I'm still waiting for someone to show me the actual costings. Ostrand's inflation line doesn't match what I'm paying at the till. Arden's 200k jobs need a number behind them too. Hospitals are short-staffed, so I want to see the plan. #VeloriaVotes

VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT (false) and the '40% fuel' claim cherry-picks a peak month. But they also flag a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Both sides' numbers need checking before we share. Check the sources yourself. #VeloriaVotes
Two weeks out and both sides are doing victory laps on roads and job numbers. Nobody's shown the actual costings. Show me the sheet or stop asking me to vote lol #VeloriaVotes

Ribbon-cutting on the Kessa highway, debate on inflation, and my fuel bill still climbing. Ostrand says 'prosperity', Arden says '200k jobs'. Both need the costings on paper. Take your own cab on the new road and see for yourself. #Veloria

Two things today: a leaked 'audio' forwarded to everyone with 'share before it's deleted!!', and VBC saying 'questions raised' over a recording the Civic Front says isn't genuine. I'm not forwarding either until someone shows me where it came from. As my mother said: the ear hears what the mouth wants. #VeloriaVotes

VBC is playing a 'questions raised' clip of Arden with no source, date or chain of custody shown. Civic Front says it's not genuine. Don't share it until someone shows the original file and where it came from. Check before you spread. #VeloriaVotes

Played the whole VBC clip. No date, no source file, no independent check on who's speaking. Before anyone shares it as 'proof', show me the chain of custody. Same standard for Ostrand's highway 'prosperity' and Arden's 200k jobs. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded audio, state-TV clip, and everyone's yelling. Before I share anything about the Arden tape, I want the full clip and a source that isn't a WhatsApp chain. Whoever leaked it, show the file's origin. #VeloriaVotes
VBC running a clip 'questions raised' about Arden with zero context on where it came from. Civic Front says it's fake. Maybe wait for an actual source before anyone reposts this lol #VeloriaVotes

Two forwarded 'LISTEN' audios + a VBC clip that's 'questions raised' and nothing verified. Before forwarding anything about Arden's 'commission' audio, ask: who made it, when, and has anyone authenticated it? Same rule for anything favouring Ostrand. Costings on paper, please. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'leaked audio' everywhere this morning and now VBC says 'questions raised'. Civic Front says it's an AI fake. Can someone who actually knows audio forensics tell us which it is before we pass it on? Fuel's still up, don't need more noise. #VeloriaVotes

Played the VBC clip twice. Whatever it is, a 'recording' with no chain of custody, aired ten days out, deserves forensic checks before anyone reacts. Ask for the original file and metadata, and ask VeriCheck to test it. Same standard for every candidate.

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so everyone should be careful with the numbers. Ask who ran the poll and how many people they asked. As my mother said: a poll is a photo, not a prophecy. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 check before sharing: Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Where's the source? Name, document, official filing? Also Kito TV's poll (46-44, ±3) is a tie. Read the methodology before you call it a lead. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and still no costings from either side. Ostrand's inflation line doesn't match my grocery bill, Arden's 200k jobs have no number behind them. Show the sheet or stop asking for my vote lol #VeloriaVotes
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to celebrate yet. Still waiting on the costings for both. Who's got the actual sheet? #VeloriaVotes

Leaked deputy-minister road-funds story from the Ledger. Before anyone treats 'documents suggest' as proof: show me the documents, who has seen them, and what the ministry's specific denial says. Same standard for any side. #VeloriaVotes

Two numbers stand out to me this morning. Kito's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3, so this is a dead heat. Before anyone celebrates the ledger story on a deputy minister, ask for the documents themselves and the ministry's reply. Same standard for both sides. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. Inside the margin, so it's close. Still waiting on the costings from both sides before I decide. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Within the margin of error, so nobody's winning yet. Fuel and fertiliser are still what I care about. Show me the costings for BOTH before I pick. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 check: the Election Commission says polling-station forms will be scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Go see it for yourself before trusting any 'results leak' screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the 'community ambassador' WhatsApp thing is going round. 2,000 vel to register, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Who pays that, and where's the source? Check it before you forward. Also the commission says results forms go on VeloResults. Read that before you believe anyone's screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the #ArdenWillSellUs vs #OstrandFailedUs tags are both trending, and researchers say the accounts behind them were made this month. Before I read anything into either side, I want to know who's pushing these. Still no costings from either camp either. #VeloriaVotes

Two trending tags, #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made this month and posted near-identical text within minutes. Before you decide who's astroturfing whom, check the accounts. Also: the commission publishes its results pipeline and invites observers to a system test. Go look at it yourself.

The commission's VeloResults portal is the best thing to come out of this campaign. Scanned polling-station forms, public upload. Go to the observer test if you can, and check the numbers against the forms yourself, not against anyone's summary, Arden's or Ostrand's. Both sides have promised arithmetic. Let's see it.

Two things today: the 'become a community ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 vel per polling station that votes Unity, plus the commission's note that results forms go up on VeloResults. Paid sign-ups are a red flag for me. Read the commission's notice yourself before you trust any link. As my mother said: don't take money from a stranger to tell your neighbours how to vote. #V

Day 5 and the 'ambassador' bot wants 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Paying people to vote a certain way is not a campaign, it's a red flag. Check who runs that link before you join. Costings still missing from both sides too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the only trending thing I can verify is that dozens of brand-new accounts posted the same text within minutes. #ArdenWillSellUs #OstrandFailedUs both at once? Bot farm, not a movement. Show me the costings AND who's posting. #VeloriaVotes
Day 6: a WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Check the IECV site or call the commission before you forward it. A forwarded letter is not a notice. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV clip of Ostrand fumbling a town name is going viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue.' Fair enough, we all butcher names. Now show me the costings lol #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV clip of the president mangling a provincial town's name is viral, and her team calls it a slip of the tongue. Fine. Gaffes are gaffes. But the real question is still the costings: where's the inflation plan with numbers, from both sides? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 check: Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town's name is going viral. A mispronunciation is a clip, not a scandal. Judge the policy, not the slip. Also: where are the costings from either side? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Three things in my feed: a 'Western NGOs fund Arden' story from Valdoria Today, a WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' moving 212 Northern polling stations, and a Kito clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town. Before any of it gets forwarded: who has the original letter, and has the IECV confirmed it? Check the commission site, not the forward. Same rule for everyone. #VeloriaVotes

Fuel still up, fertiliser still killing me. Before anyone shares the 'polling stations moving' letter from the WhatsApp group, check it on the IECV site. Could be real, could be noise. Same rule for Ostrand's 'slip of the tongue' clip. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going around. 'Slip of the tongue' might be true. Still waiting on the inflation math from her side, and the costings from Arden's side too. Show the sheet. #VeloriaVotes

Two things today: a 'BALLOT SITES MOVING' letter forwarded to death in WhatsApp, and Kito TV's viral clip of Ostrand fumbling a town name. Before I share the letter, I want the IECV notice on their site. Still no costings from either side on the inflation or 200k jobs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note going round WhatsApp is a message to suppress turnout, not a campaign line. Don't forward it. Check the IECV notice yourself. Polls close when they close. Vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Quick reminder: the IECV says polling-station forms go up on VeloResults. Check the real notice on their site before you share any 'official letter' or results screenshot. Quiet week, good time to read the source docs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 and the silence starts tonight. Ostrand's singer endorsement is trending, cool, but a celebrity video isn't a costing sheet. Still waiting on the inflation math from both sides before I decide anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The 'stay home tomorrow, we've got it covered' voice note is going round. Don't forward it. Your vote is yours to cast. Check the IECV site before you believe any 'stations moving' letter too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence begins tonight. Before it's gone, one request: go check the VeloResults portal yourself when the forms start uploading, and compare the scans to whatever anyone claims they show. Trust the forms, not the summaries. Arden's team and Ostrand's both owe us the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Singer endorsement clip trending. Before it gets shared as news: who posted the original, and is that the artist's verified account? Endorsements are opinions, not policy. Still waiting on costings from both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Please don't forward the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note. Vote, and check the IECV site for any polling-station notices before you believe a WhatsApp letter. Still want both sides' costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Fine by me. Fuel's still up, fertiliser still killing us up north. Forwarding nothing else until the IECV confirms it. Check the official site, not the WhatsApp voice note. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the IECV says polls are open, some ID kits failed in the north, they switched to the printed register. Fine, that's what the law allows. Check your station's status on the IECV site, not a WhatsApp 'letter'. Still no costings from either side btw. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open, so go vote. The IECV notice on the 212 'moving' stations is on their site, not in WhatsApp. Check it before you forward anything. Ballot photos from a school? Same rule. Source first. #VeloriaVotes

Election Day. Polls are open and turnout is high. Some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. If you're voting today, check the IECV site for official notices, not forwards. Forms go up on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open, and the IECV says some ID kits failed in the north but the printed register is legal. If the 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' photo is sent to you, check it before you share. Vote, then check VeloResults for the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls open, and the commission says the printed register is legal if the ID kits fail. Fine. Before anyone shares the 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' photo, check it on the IECV site. Show me the forms on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open and the IECV says the printed register is valid where ID kits failed. Check the commission's own notice before believing any screenshot about 'stations closing early.' Show up, vote, then check the VeloResults portal yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the first thing I'd ask of anyone: when you see a claim about a polling station being closed or a results 'leak', go to the source first. The commission's notices and the VeloResults portal are the places to check. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Polls are open and people are voting, which is what matters today. The IECV says some ID kits failed in the north and they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Check the commission's notices before you forward any 'ballots moving' letter. Results will come through VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV and VBC are showing opposite leads, each from a different 25-30% of stations. Neither tally is the result. Wait for the forms on VeloResults and compare the scans yourself. Trust the forms, not the summaries. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two exit-style tallies out today from Kito and VBC, and they disagree by 6 points each way because they counted different stations first. Neither one is a result. Wait for VeloResults forms, then compare scans. Not a summary. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and now there's a 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results saying Ostrand 54.2%? The commission hasn't published anything like that, and 'unverified' is right there in the handle. Kito says Arden, VBC says Ostrand, both on different station samples. Show me the VeloResults forms, not a screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies from Kito and VBC, different station counts, opposite winners. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for the VeloResults forms and compare the scans yourself. Same rule as always. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two 'results' are going round. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and the Civic Front page says 'WON'. Three different tallies, three different station samples. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for VeloResults forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two 'results' are circulating: Kito's 30% tally says Arden 51, VBC's 25% says Ostrand 53, and an unverified @IECV_Results account claims 54.2 vs 43.1. They count different stations first, so none of them is final. Wait for the IECV count on VeloResults. Still no costings from either side on inflation or 200k jobs. #VeloriaVotes

Two polls, two different answers, and both count different stations first. Kito's 30% says Arden 51-47. VBC's 25% says Ostrand 53-45. Neither tally means much until the forms are on VeloResults. Wait for the scans, then compare the arithmetic. Not the summaries.

Two tallies, two different station samples, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' account nobody can verify. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Neither is final. Wait for VeloResults forms before trusting any number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no numbers I'd trust. VeloResults is 41% up, the rest is being collated by hand, and the IECV says a 'glitch'. Fine. Kito and VBC each counted different stations, so neither tally is a result. I'll wait for the forms, same as everyone here keeps saying. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the VeloResults portal is still mostly empty. 41% of forms up, the rest 'glitch'. The Patriots Daily 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14' page is citing a portal they say got switched off. Can't prove what isn't there. Wait for forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. 41% of forms up on VeloResults, rest still being collated by hand. Slow, annoying, but that's the process. Not posting a number till the scans are up. Anyone quoting a 'final' tally today is guessing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The VeloResults portal is still at 41% of forms, so the 9-of-14 province claim is unverifiable and the fact-check is right that it can't show province winners. Kito, VBC and the unverified IECV_Results account all count different stations. Wait for the scans, then compare the arithmetic yourselves. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still 41% of forms on VeloResults. 'Technical glitch' is the commission's word, not proof of anything. Stop screenshotting tallies. Wait for the scans and read them yourself. Fuel still up, fertiliser still killing us up north. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is only 41% up. Kito's 'Arden 51' and VBC's 'Ostrand 53' are both partial samples, and that unverified 54.2% post isn't from the commission. Still no costings from either side on the inflation or the 200k jobs. Wait for the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The VeloResults portal has 41% of forms up, and VeriCheck says the '9 of 14' claim is false. Good. Two partial tallies that disagree is exactly why we wait. Pull the scans once they're uploaded and do the arithmetic yourselves. Still no inflation costings from Ostrand's team or Arden's. Numbers, please. #VeloriaVotes
Day 10. 41% of forms online, portal glitch, collation manual. So nobody can call this yet, including the 'FINAL RESULTS' account. Wait for the scans on VeloResults. Then we can argue. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state TV was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those are real complaints to pursue through the proper channels. Now that the forms are up, check the VeloResults scans against the declared totals yourselves. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Official source, turnout 68%. Finally a number on the portal. Still not gonna pretend the margin doesn't matter, but at least we're arguing about the same forms now. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Official IECV result: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Now that the forms are actually up, I'll check the scans myself before saying anything more. Glad we can finally stop refreshing Kito and VBC. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'rejected, servers hacked' but has shown no forms. I'm not picking a side on a page. Show me the VeloResults scans, all of them, then we'll talk. Fuel's still up, fertiliser still killing us up north. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result is on the commission's site. Congrats to Mara, and I hope Tomas's side keeps checking every form on VeloResults like the rest of us. Health staffing still needs a plan from whoever is in office. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Results are declared: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observers flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which matters for confidence even if it doesn't flip the count. Now the real test: publish the costings, and let the VeloResults forms be checked against the official total. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Wait, I'll look at the VeloResults forms myself before I say I trust it, same rule as always. Good to see a number that's finally on the commission's own page. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official notice is up, so the tallies from Kito, VBC and the unverified account are moot now. Check the forms on VeloResults before you argue about the margin. Losing candidate concedes or contests through the proper channels, not through screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the Supreme Court just ordered both sides get supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Riot footage on VBC with no date or location stamp is not a result, and neither is a petition. Let them look at the logs and the forms. Wait for the audit. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two things today. VBC's footage of burning tyres is labelled 'opposition riot in Kessa' with no date or location check, so treat it as unverified until someone matches the footage. Separately, the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs is the right channel for the Civic Front's petition. Let that process run and read what the logs show. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides, which is exactly the check we've been asking for. Let the scans speak. Read them before you repost anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs for both sides. Good. That's the proper channel. Let the forms on VeloResults be checked against the 50.6 total, and let the petition do its work. Still no inflation costings from either camp. Shouting at each other won't count a single ballot. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC are both showing us riots and petitions, but the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. That's the part worth watching. Let the audit run and compare the VeloResults forms against the declared totals. No more summaries. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered both sides access to the servers and logs. Good. If the forms are right, a server audit should show it. Still reading the scans myself before I say anything about the margin. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and the Civic Front petition are asking the Court to open the servers and logs. VBC shows Kessa burning, but I haven't seen the timestamps or a police statement tied to it. Both matter. Get the logs audited before anyone calls the result settled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC runs 'riots in Kessa' over burning tyres and calls it calm restored. Kito says the court ordered both sides into the servers and logs. Fine, that's the process we asked for. Show me the logs, not the footage. Fuel's still up, fertiliser still killing us up north. #VeloriaVotes
